correctness.rationale: From the exact 30-edge icosahedral graph, independently enumerated all 4096 subsets under induced maximum degree <=1: 323 nonempty faces with f=(12,66,140,105). Lexicographic matching gave 149 pairs and critical cells (1,0,2,22), and topological sort verified all 972 Hasse arcs acyclic. Independently eliminated each paired 2/3-cell by signed integer pivots, reproducing all 22 Morse boundary columns and a determinant-one 2x2 minor, giving integral wedge of 20 S3 by Hurewicz and cancellation. Generated the full 120-symmetry group from two explicit graph permutations, used signed simplicial Lefschetz traces, obtained central-inversion +/− ranks 15/5 and full-group invariant dimension 1. The rational quotient claim follows by invariant rational chains after subdivision, not integral quotient equivalence.
